newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Sampoerna eyes 15 pct stake in Indofood.
newsitem.headline: Sampoerna eyes 15 pct stake in Indofood.

text.p: Indonesian tobacco tycoon Putera Sampoerna has long-term plans to take a 15-percent stake in leading noodle-maker PT Indofood Sukses Makmur, an executive of PT Hanjaya Mandala Sampoerna said on Thursday.

Ekadharmajanto Kasih, chief financial officer of PT Sampoerna, confirmed that Putera Sampoerna, the founder and president director of PT Sampoerna, had bought a 5.63 percent stake in Indofood, amounting to about 85.9 million shares at 5,800 rupiah each.
He said Putera Sampoerna's purchase was made in his personal capacity on Tuesday on the Surabaya Stock Exchange through a cross-trade.
Indofood opened 225 rupiah higher at 6,000 rupiah on Thursday, but eased to 5,800 rupiah early in the second session on profit-taking.
"For long-term planning, Sampoerna plans to have about a 15 percent stake in Indofood," Kasih said.
He said Putera Sampoerna's acquisition of an Indofood stake could open the possibility of future cooperation between PT Sampoerna and Indofood, which is part of the Salim Group.
